description:
Create a formal response letter for the FOIA case 'FOIA-Correspondence-Test-2025'. Log in as 'arkcase-admin@dev.arkcase.com' (password: 'ArkCase1234!'). Navigate to the complaint case titled 'FOIA-Correspondence-Test-2025'. Open the 'Correspondence' (or Letters) section of the case and create a new correspondence entry. Fill in the following details:

- **Type:** Response Letter (or Letter)
- **Subject:** Official Response - Records Request Determination
- **Body:** Dear Requester, after careful review of your Freedom of Information Act request dated May 15, 2025, we have determined that the requested records are releasable in full. Please find the enclosed documents responsive to your request. If you have questions regarding this determination, you may contact our FOIA office. Sincerely, FOIA Processing Team.

Save the correspondence to the case record.
